logic: A political slur used to label anyone perceived as pro-China or anti-government.
From a news clip of a woman describing cantaloupe (Hami-gua), used to mock weird personal tastes.
Used to mock financial scandals or 'fake' transparency.
Direct Mandarin translation of 'Khàu-pē' (Hokkien), used to tell someone to shut up or stop complaining.
Phonetic Mandarin 'Xiǎng huā Q' sounds like 'I want to Fuck You'.
Used to mock Chen Shui-bian's legal status, or anyone 'faking' sickness to escape duty.
Mandarin transliteration of Hokkien 'Lín-pē' (Your father/I, your father), used assertively or rudely.
Mandarin 'Jī bāi' masks the Hokkien 'Tsi-bai' (Vagina), used as a general insult for being annoying.
Used sarcastically for Kaohsiung politicians when disasters happen (mocking the 'Warm City' branding).
